name: Power from wind
summary: Treadmill motors and direct-drive washing machine motors are the classic scavenged wind generators: permanent magnets, slow speeds, real power. Height matters more than anything; get it well clear of trees and buildings. Most places have less steady wind than people think, so watch the wind for a few weeks before building big. Small ready-made turbines hide on boats, RVs and remote cabins.

parts.why: Ready-made turbines from boats, cabins and RVs
Treadmill motors make good homemade wind generators
Direct-drive washer motors generate well at slow speeds
Wind controllers with a dump load protect the battery
Turns AC or three-phase output into DC
A dump load burns off spare power

tips: Mount the turbine at least 9 m above anything within about 90 m.
Never let a turbine spin with nothing connected. Shorting a permanent-magnet generator’s leads brakes it in a storm.
Add a blocking diode so the battery can’t spin a DC motor like a fan.
Towers fall. Guy them well and never climb one in wind.
